title: providerPickerReading
responsibility: Reads model picker responses: snapshots, queued sessions, selection labels and failure text.

inputs.name: isSnapshot.data
inputs.description: The picker response to check, or null. A value is a snapshot only when it is not null and has a 'defaultProvider' property (own or inherited), whatever that property holds; the check never reads the property's value or any other field.

examples.message: Desktop control connection unavailable. Requests stay pending; no provider settings change.

inputs.name: readSessions.data
inputs.description: A response to a queued-sessions request, or null. Only its 'sessions' property is read, and a null input, a missing property or a non-array value all give null.

inputs.name: selectionLabel.models
inputs.description: The catalog of PickerModel entries to search. Only the first entry whose provider and model both equal the target's supplies the label, so later duplicates are ignored, and an empty array is valid (the model id is then the label).

inputs.name: selectionLabel.target
inputs.description: The selection of the queued switch to label. Only its provider and model are compared with the catalog, so its effort never changes the label.

inputs.name: failureText.cause
inputs.description: Whatever was thrown or rejected (ThrownValue is unknown). Only an Error instance contributes its message; any other value, including a string, null or a plain object with a message property, yields the fallback.

inputs.name: failureText.fallback
inputs.description: The text returned when the cause is not an Error instance, and it is returned unchanged. An Error's message wins even when it is empty, so the fallback applies only to values that are not Error instances.

outputs.name: isSnapshot
outputs.description: True when the response is not null and has a 'defaultProvider' property, which narrows the argument to PickerSnapshot; false otherwise, including for null. It never inspects the property's value or any other field.

outputs.name: readSessions
outputs.description: The response's 'sessions' array, returned unchanged including when it is empty, or null when the response holds no array there. A null result means no list was present, while [] means a list with no queued sessions.

outputs.name: selectionLabel
outputs.description: The 'label' of the first catalog entry whose provider and model both equal the target's, or the target's model id when no entry matches or that entry's label is null or undefined. Because the id fallback is the raw model string, a result such as 'gpt-4.1' is an id rather than a display name.

outputs.name: failureText
outputs.description: The message of the cause when it is an Error instance, returned even when empty, otherwise the fallback text unchanged. A message is never read from a value that is not an Error instance.
examples: Desktop control connection unavailable. Requests stay pending; no provider settings change.
